description: Implementation of UnixDomainServerSocket class for handling UNIX domain socket server operations, including binding, listening, accepting connections, and retrieving peer credentials.

classes.name: UnixDomainServerSocket
classes.description: A class that manages UNIX domain socket server operations, including binding, listening, accepting connections, and peer credential verification.

methods.name: GetPeerCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves the credentials of the peer connected via UNIX domain socket, using platform-specific system calls.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Stub method for listening on an IPv6 address, not implemented.

methods.name: ListenWithAddressAndPort
methods.description: Stub method for listening with address and port, not implemented.

methods.name: BindAndListen
methods.description: Binds a UNIX domain socket to a specified path and starts listening with a given backlog.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Returns an error indicating UNIX domain sockets do not have a valid address/port.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, providing a socket or descriptor via callback.

methods.name: AcceptSocketDescriptor
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection as a socket descriptor, with callback.

methods.name: DoAccept
methods.description: Performs the accept operation in a loop until a valid connection is authenticated.

methods.name: AcceptCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of accept operation, handles authentication and socket setup.

methods.name: AuthenticateAndGetStreamSocket
methods.description: Authenticates the peer credentials and sets up the socket if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: SetSocketResult
methods.description: Assigns the accepted socket to the output pointer, either as a stream or descriptor.

methods.name: RunCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored callback with the result of accept operation.

methods.name: CancelCallback
methods.description: Resets the callback and output socket pointers.
